cues: In sixteen eighty six, Newton had to decide how the gas is squeezed as sound passes.
He argued that the squeezing is gentle, so any heat produced in a compression leaks away at once.
In other words, an isothermal change.
text: In sixteen eighty six, Newton had to decide how the gas is squeezed as sound passes. He argued that the squeezing is gentle, so any heat produced in a compression leaks away at once. The temperature stays constant. In other words, an isothermal change.
